pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Visible dark regions exhibit sharp pixel-intensity transitions at the margins, defining clear polygonal geometries. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, with larger tessellated polygons on the lateral flank and smaller units on the posterior limb region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch pathways form a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel width of pathways is consistent across the lateral torso, maintaining high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents as a continuous 1D contour with a fine, jagged edge against the background. The amplitude of individual bristles is low, creating a densely packed serrated profile.
